title: Lattice generation of Lipschitz functions over divisible ordered abelian groups
author: Antoine Ducros; Ehud Hrushovski; François Loeser; Jinhe Ye
difficulty_reason: After ordinary DOAG model completeness and the cited special linear cell decomposition, the authors still prove parameter descent, a lattice-combination characterization and a separating hyperplane construction for closed cells. The main proof then inducts on nontrivial convex subgroups, passes to a quotient and constructs cell-pair functions bounding the given Lipschitz function on opposite sides. This new parameter-sensitive non-Archimedean separation and lattice-generation argument is substantially beyond ordinary doctoral qualification exercises.
